definition: βέβηλος, -ον  (βαίνω, whence βηλός, a threshold), [in LXX chiefly for חֹל ;]  __1. permitted to be trodden, accessible (see DCG, ii, 422b); hence,  __2. (opposite to ἱερός) unhallowed, profane: of things, 1Ti.4:7 6:20, 2Ti.2:16; of men, 1Ti.1:9, Heb.12:16 (cf. κοινός; Cremer, 140).† (AS)
